connect.title: Connect to your Jarvis
connect.lead: Jarvis runs at your home. This app is only the window to it.
connect.scanHelp: Open the Jarvis web interface under System → Connections and scan the server-address QR code. Then enter your password.
connect.urlHelp: The internet address of your Jarvis, for example https://jarvis.yourname.com. You chose it when you set up the Cloudflare tunnel; it's listed in the settings under “Access & remote”.
connect.passwordHelp: The password you chose for yourself during setup.
connect.noPassword: This server has no owner password yet. Open its address in a browser and finish setup.
connect.notJarvis: No Jarvis answers at this address.
connect.tooNew: This Jarvis is newer than the app. Please update the app.
connect.badCode: This code does not contain a valid Jarvis server address.
connect.cameraAsk: The camera is only used to scan the server address.
connect.cameraDenied: No camera access. You can also enter the address.
connect.demoHelp: Shows the app with sample data. Nothing leaves this device.
connect.private: Your data stays on your server. The app stores only the address and a device key.
connect.independent: Jarvis is an independent project, not affiliated with WhatsApp or Meta.

setup.accountLead: You'll find the setup code in the admin service's log. Then choose a password for administration.
setup.name: What's your name?

setup.aiLead: Optional. With an OpenAI key Jarvis sorts your chats into topics, transcribes voice messages faster and finds things by meaning. Without it everything runs locally.
setup.remoteLead: Optional. A Cloudflare tunnel lets you reach Jarvis and the app outside your Wi-Fi without opening ports.
setup.reviewLead: This will be saved. Then Jarvis starts its services.
setup.already: Jarvis is already set up. Make changes under Settings.

welcome.title: Welcome to Jarvis
welcome.lead: A few steps and your Jarvis is ready. Everything stays on your device at home; only the AI provider you pick next receives selected text to analyse.

account.title: Your access
account.lead: You find the setup code in the admin service log. Then choose a password for the admin area.

database.title: Existing data
database.lead: This device already holds a Jarvis archive. Enter its two passwords, otherwise Jarvis cannot reach your messages. They are in your old .env or your password manager.

name.title: What's your name?
name.lead: Jarvis uses it in summaries and profiles.

provider.title: AI provider
provider.lead: Jarvis needs a language model to sort chats, suggest replies and answer your questions. Any provider with an OpenAI-compatible API works, including a model running at home.

models.title: Models
models.lead: One model per job. Small models are fine for sorting; replies and questions benefit from a stronger one.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: Decide what must never reach the AI. This applies from the first message.

features.title: What Jarvis may do
features.lead: You can change all of this later in settings.

remote.title: On the go
remote.lead: Optional. A Cloudflare tunnel lets you reach Jarvis and the app outside your Wi-Fi without opening ports. You enter the public address in the app later.

review.title: Check everything
review.lead: This gets saved, then Jarvis starts its services.

consent.title: Before you start
consent.lead: Two things you should know and confirm.

openai.name: OpenAI
openai.desc: GPT models. Also handles voice messages and meaning search.

anthropic.name: Anthropic
anthropic.desc: Claude models. Voice and search then run locally.

openrouter.name: OpenRouter
openrouter.desc: One key for many providers: Gemini, Mistral, Llama and more.

ollama.name: Ollama, at home
ollama.desc: Models on your own computer. Nothing leaves your network and it's free, but slower.

custom.name: Other provider
custom.desc: Any OpenAI-compatible address, for example Mistral, Groq or LM Studio.

none.name: No AI
none.desc: Archive and search work, but no topics, cards or reply suggestions.

app.title: Replies and questions
app.desc: Reply suggestions, Ask Jarvis, the line under the figure.

organizer.title: Sorting
organizer.desc: Reads every message once and turns it into topics, dates and cards. Runs most often.

images.title: Images
images.desc: Describes shared photos so you can search them. Needs a model that understands images.

ORGANIZER_ENABLED.title: Topics and cards
ORGANIZER_ENABLED.desc: Jarvis sorts your chats and prepares decisions.

ENABLE_ACTIONS.title: Send on your behalf
ENABLE_ACTIONS.desc: Replies, reactions and votes, only when you tap them.

REQUIRE_CONFIRM.title: Always ask first
REQUIRE_CONFIRM.desc: Claude also shows every message before sending.

ENABLE_MEMORY.title: Memory
ENABLE_MEMORY.desc: Jarvis remembers what you correct and tell it.

consent.whatsapp: Jarvis is an independent project and not affiliated with WhatsApp or Meta. The WhatsApp connection is unofficial (Baileys as a linked device), may violate the WhatsApp Terms of Service and can get my account banned.

consent.responsibility: Your archive contains other people's messages; you are responsible for handling them lawfully (e.g. GDPR).

legal.title: Legal notes
legal.sub: Short and honest, what you should know.

sections.title: Independent project
sections.body: Jarvis is an independent open-source project. It is not affiliated with, supported or approved by WhatsApp or Meta. WhatsApp is a trademark of WhatsApp LLC.

sections.title: Unofficial WhatsApp connection
sections.body: Jarvis connects to your WhatsApp account as a linked device through the Baileys library. This is not an official interface and may violate the WhatsApp Terms of Service. WhatsApp can restrict or ban your account, and the connection can stop working at any time. Use it at your own risk; consider a secondary number.

sections.title: AI provider
sections.body: If you enable AI features, message content is sent to the configured AI provider (for example OpenAI), including messages from your contacts, voice transcripts and image descriptions. The provider's terms and privacy policy apply. Excluded chats and redaction limit this. Without a key, processing stays local.

sections.title: Other people's messages
sections.body: The archive contains messages from other people. You are responsible for handling them lawfully, for example under the GDPR.

sections.title: No warranty
sections.body: Jarvis is provided as is, without warranty of any kind.
